window.title: Window
window.description: Window mode quits on close. Launcher hides on Esc or click outside, and keeps running in the tray.
window.appCard: Normal window in the taskbar or Dock. Closing quits Kensaku.
window.launcherCard: Floating palette summoned by a shortcut. Closing hides it to the tray.

invocation.title: Invocation
invocation.shortcutLauncher: Press it from anywhere to open search. Click, then press a combo to change it. On Linux Wayland, desktops may block global keys: bind a shortcut to the command kensaku --toggle instead.
invocation.shortcutApp: Only used in launcher mode; the desktop app opens from the taskbar.
invocation.maxResultsDescription: Hard ceiling per query. Lower keeps rendering instant.
invocation.startAtLoginDescription: Launch Kensaku when you sign in.

folders.title: Watched directories
folders.drop: Drop folders here to add them for watching

exclusions.directoryPlaceholder: directory name, e.g. bundle_cache — Enter to add
exclusions.skipHiddenDescription: Skip files and folders whose name starts with a dot. Turn off to index hidden files.

search.showThumbnailsDescription: Previews for images and PDFs (first page). PDFs need poppler, e.g. brew install poppler. Without it, PDFs show their file icon. Turn off to skip previews.
search.layoutDescription: Grid shows image cards. List shows one file per row, with size and age.
search.semanticDescription: Static embeddings, ~0.1 ms per query, fused with BM25 via RRF.
search.crawlModeDescription: Balanced uses idle I/O and CPU priority. Eco also paces work on battery. Full speed keeps normal priority.
search.pauseDescription: Stops reading new files. Renames and deletes still update the index while paused.
search.aliasesDescription: Personal vocabulary: typing the term also matches any of its expansions (case-insensitive, OR semantics).

ai.modelDescription: Static embeddings — no GPU, no network.
ai.readinessDescription: Units searchable in RRF fusion right now.
ai.f32Description: Keep the static embedding table in f32 instead of the compact i8 table. For quality comparisons only.

agents.intro: Let agents search this index. Read-only by default, local, no network.
agents.connectNote: Adding Kensaku merges one entry into the client's config file (a backup is left next to it). Restart the client afterwards. Manual JSON stays available above.
agents.mcpDescription: Point Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client at the kensaku-cli binary. It reuses this app's data directory: it attaches to the daemon when one is running, otherwise it reads the index read-only.
agents.pathNote: If kensaku-cli isn't on your PATH, use the absolute path to the binary — ~/.cargo/bin/kensaku-cli or target/release/kensaku-cli.
agents.cliNote: When the daemon is running the MCP server forwards queries to it and never opens the database itself. Without a daemon it falls back to the read-only local index.
agents.allowReindexDescription: Adds an opt-in reindex tool for agents. Requires the daemon; restart MCP clients after changing this.
agents.securityDescription: Read-only by default. reindex is off unless enabled above. No shell and no network. Honors your watched folders, exclusions and the daemon's opt-in check.

about.resetPending: A reset is pending and will finish on next launch.
about.autoUpdate: Automatic update checking is enabled by default.
about.opensRelease: Opens the latest release page in your browser.
about.howToIntro: A few simple tricks make search feel instant:
about.tipTab: shows or hides the details pane next to results.
about.tipAliases: let a word like “resume” also find “cv” and “curriculum”.
about.tipSlash: opens the command menu for quick actions like {{dupes}}, {{doctor}} and {{settings}}.
about.tipAt: mentions a folder to search inside it.
about.tipSort: and saved searches keep your best queries one click away.
about.tipPin: important files so they stay on the home screen.
about.tipOcr: reads text inside images and screenshots.
about.staysLocal: Everything stays on your computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
about.thesisQuote: “A warm, local, read-only index of your machine that answers in under 15 ms — for you, and for every agent you use.”
about.rerunDescription: Re-run the guided first-run flow (folders, preferences, optional packs, first scan). Your index and config are preserved; setup markers reset.
about.resetDescription: Deletes the index, metadata database, downloaded models, and settings. This cannot be undone.

resetDialog.title: Reset Kensaku
resetDialog.body: This will delete your index and settings and restart Kensaku.
resetDialog.packsTitle: Also delete downloaded OCR and model packs
resetDialog.packsBody: Off by default. Keeping them means search works immediately after the reset instead of waiting for a re-download.

about.autoUpdateSettingDesc: Periodically checks for new releases and improvements in the background.
about.noAssetFound: No compatible package found for your platform. Please download from GitHub.

models.title: Model files
models.directoryDescription: Where the model files live on disk.
models.onDiskDescription: Bytes of the neural tier present / expected.
models.unavailable: Model status unavailable — the backend command is not connected yet.
models.retryHint: Use About → Run setup again to retry the download.
models.notDownloaded: Not downloaded. 29.5 MB in total; semantic search uses a hashing fallback until then.
models.note: The default semantic tier is built in. These files pre-fetch the optional neural tier for offline use.
models.deleteHint: Delete the downloaded model files to reclaim space.

ocr.title: OCR (images)
ocr.description: Read text from screenshots, scans and photos. PP-OCRv6 is the default (best recall on dense UI, fastest batch); Indra OCR is the multilingual/rotated-scan option; Tesseract is the clean-text fallback where neither can run. Existing images are re-scanned after saving.
ocr.engineDescription: Pick one. All read images; they are alternatives.
ocr.ppocrBlurb: About 6 MB · runs inside Kensaku · highest token recall on dense UI screenshots, fastest batch throughput; best default for screenshot search.
ocr.indraBlurb: About 27 MB · runs inside Kensaku · 80+ languages, rotated/skewed scans and tilted pages; comparable recall to PP-OCR, slightly slower on simple images. Model weights under a modified OpenRAIL-M license.
ocr.readyVerified: {{name}} ready · verified on a test image
ocr.notFound: tesseract not found or not runnable.
ocr.noLanguages: OCR engine found, but no language data.
ocr.notCompiled: {{name}} is not compiled into this build. Rebuild with default features to enable it.
ocr.languageData: Language data is downloaded during setup. Use About → Run setup again to acquire it, then re-check here.
ocr.languagesDescription: Images are read in these languages. Leave all unselected to use English.

doctor.idleDescription: A pass over the full-text index, the file watcher, the metadata database and the model files. Everything runs on your machine — nothing is sent anywhere.
doctor.unavailableDescription: The run_doctor command did not answer. It should appear once the backend lands; the checks stay local and read-only.
doctor.reportTooltip: Open a pre-filled issue report on GitHub
doctor.hasIssuesNotice: Diagnostics flagged an issue. You can open a pre-filled bug report directly on GitHub.

stats.waiting: waiting for get_stats — showing zeroed placeholders
stats.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild the index from scratch? Kensaku clears the full-text index, semantic units and thumbnails, then rescans your folders.
stats.lastReconcileDescription: How fresh the index is, right now.
